load_emb: load embedding shards from multiple files and concatenate them into a single torch tensor
batchify: split a torch tensor into batches of a specified size for batched processing
shuffle_data: shuffle and batchify multiple aligned data tensors using the same random index order
get_model_pred: get model predictions by running a model on source, reference, and machine translation inputs in batches
get_pearson_corr: compute the Pearson correlation between model predictions and ground truth labels for evaluation
get_linear_schedule_with_warmup: create a linear learning rate scheduler with a warmup phase for PyTorch optimizers
